page_title: NOT 1-0 IPS | Nottingham Forest v Ipswich 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich.
90+6' A corner kick by Nottingham is thwarted by the well prepared Arijanet Muric (Ipswich).
90+3' Jack Taylor (Ipswich) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

90' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ipswich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
88' Today's match ends for Callum Hudson-Odoi who will be replaced by Ramon Sosa (Nottingham).
85' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Ipswich.
79' Here's the change. Omari Hutchinson leaves the pitch and Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) comes on as a substitute.
79' Substitution. Axel Tuanzebe did his best and is replaced by Harrison Clarke (Ipswich).
78' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Jota Silva and he is replaced by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Morato (Nottingham) will replace Morgan Gibbs-White.
77' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to make a change. Alex Moreno (Nottingham) replaces Neco Williams.
74' Substitution. Wes Burns (Ipswich) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Conor Chaplin walks off.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jack Taylor (Ipswich) comes onto the pitch so that Jens Cajuste can be given a rest.
74' Nottingham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
71' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Elliot Anderson will be replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
69' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
66' Wonderful movement by Nottingham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
64' Substitution. Jack Clarke (Ipswich) in, Sammie Szmodics out.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
61' The Ipswich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
60' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
59' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
58' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nottingham.
57' Nottingham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
55' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

54' What a chance! Murillo (Nottingham) jumps and powers a precise header towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper makes a spectacular reflex save and the ball deflects off his gloves onto the crossbar.
53' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

53' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
51' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
49' 1 - 0 Goal! Chris Wood (Nottingham) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Arijanet Muric into the roof of the net.
49' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is going to take the penalty!
48' Tony Harrington blows his whistle after Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee makes the call - penalty to Nottingham!
47' Neat passing move from Nottingham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' A pass from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is intercepted by Arijanet Muric and the move breaks down.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
42' 7:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
39' Great teamplay by Nottingham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

36' Ipswich slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
34' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tony Harrington blows for a foul.

34' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Matz Sels, who tips the ball around the post.
32' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
32' The game is interrupted now, Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

29' That didn't go as planned! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Arijanet Muric, who easily kept it out.
28' Jota Silva (Nottingham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
25' Jota Silva (Nottingham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is behind the touchline and Ipswich will take a throw-in.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ipswich comes to nothing.
19' Nottingham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
17' Ipswich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
13' The Nottingham players are exchanging some short passes.
12' A cross from a corner kick by Ipswich is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
11' The corner is swung in but Ipswich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
10' Ipswich are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. Good work from Ipswich as they win a corner.
10' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
8' Nottingham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
7' Nottingham fail to score from a corner as Arijanet Muric (Ipswich) leaps to collect the ball.
5' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) gets a yellow card.
5' Ipswich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
4' The Ipswich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Ipswich will kick-off.
Tony Harrington will referee today's match.
